'''Nara Shrine''' (ならじんじゃ) is a shrine located in Narachō, {{ill|Tenri, Nara|Q502196|qid=Q502196}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}.

=== Overview ===
Until around 1955 (Shōwa 30), it was called the shrine of {{ill|Kibitsuhiko-no-mikoto|Q65318|qid=Q65318|lt=Isaserihiko no Mikoto}}. It was originally on Mt. Miyama (Higashi-Ōdera-yama), but is said to have been moved to the present location because it was far from the ujiko settlement.

In 1848 (Kōka 5), {{ill|Ichikawa Danjūrō VIII|Q5986169|qid=Q5986169|lt=Ichikawa Danjūrō VIII}} dedicated a well curb.
